description.p: Inkdrop is a note-taking app built around plain Markdown. Notes live in nestable notebooks with tags and per-note statuses, stay searchable as the collection grows, and remain fully usable offline.

ul.li: A Markdown editor with syntax highlighting for code blocks in many languages, multi-cursor editing, and optional Vim keybindings
Preview with KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, footnotes and task lists
Nestable notebooks, tags, note statuses and full-text search
Encrypted sync across desktop and mobile, with complete offline use
Publishing single notes to the web as shareable pages
A built-in MCP server, so AI agents can read and write your notes

description.p: Inkdrop is proprietary software. The app runs offline against a local database, while syncing across devices requires an Inkdrop account and a paid subscription after a 30-day free trial.

About this Flatpak: updates are delivered through Flathub, and the app's own update check is disabled inside the sandbox. Home directory access is requested because the local backup location is a hand-typed path the app writes to continuously; everything else uses the file chooser portal.
